Also restored the tightly coupled omitted assertions that the Iraq and Afghanistan wars are offered as futile precedents and that U.S. air power had already killed innocent civilians. claims.claim_text: DSA condemns the Trump administration's Tomahawk cruise-missile attack in Syria.
DSA characterizes the Trump administration's Tomahawk cruise-missile attack in Syria as an act of war violating U.S. domestic law because Congress did not authorize it.
DSA characterizes the Trump administration's Tomahawk cruise-missile attack in Syria as an act of war violating international law because the United Nations did not authorize it.
DSA characterizes the U.S. wars in Iraq and Afghanistan as futile examples showing that unilateral U.S. imperial military power cannot liberate Syrians.
U.S. air power had killed scores of innocent civilians.
